app_info.subtitle: DACH workplace weather radar
app_info.description: Corporate Weather helps users understand visible workplace-weather signals across the DACH market. It turns public, evidence-style signals such as hiring activity, company communications, DACH business press indicators, and workplace review patterns into a calm, explainable report. The app does not predict layoffs and does not provide legal advice. It highlights visible risk signals, calm counter-signals, confidence, missing evidence, and what to watch next.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only opens the Corporate Weather start screen and renders an internal app view. It does not write data, change external systems, send messages, or perform transactions.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool does not need to interact with the open world. It displays the embedded start screen using app state and calibrated demo content.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive. It does not delete, modify, publish, purchase, or submit anything outside the app.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool performs read-only workplace-weather signal analysis for a company name and renders an explainable report. It does not write data or modify any external system.
justifications.open_world_justification: The current app uses deterministic demo and simulated DACH public-signal analysis, not authenticated browsing or private account access.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive. It does not make employment decisions, send notifications, publish content, change records, or perform transactions.

test_cases.description: Open the app start screen from a blank chat.
test_cases.expected_output: The premium Corporate Weather start screen opens with search, starter actions, demo mode, and examples for Delivery Hero, Intercom, Zalando, and DeepL.

test_cases.description: Analyze a common DACH company and render the full report.
test_cases.expected_output: The report opens for Zalando with a weather state, risk score, confidence, timeline, risk signals, calm signals, missing evidence, source transparency, and disclaimer.

test_cases.description: Open the DACH radar experience from chat.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the DACH Weather Map in Corporate Weather
test_cases.expected_output: The app opens and lets the user navigate to the DACH Weather Radar with demo company cards and filters for All, Clear, Watchlist, Cloudy, and Storm Warning.

test_cases.description: Analyze an unknown company without leaving the user stuck.
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze a company called Unknown Demo GmbH with Corporate Weather
test_cases.expected_output: The app does not crash or show 'No results'. It creates a cautious low-confidence report, explains missing evidence, and offers calibrated demo fallback reports.

test_cases.description: Run a high-signal demo report that shows score guardrails and confidence.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the StormAG Corporate Weather report
test_cases.expected_output: The app renders a Storm Warning demo report with high-confidence public restructuring signals, calm counter-signals, source transparency, missing evidence when applicable, and the legal-advice disclaimer.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not provide a layoff prediction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Will Zalando lay people off next month?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant should avoid predicting layoffs. It may offer to run Corporate Weather for visible public signals and should clarify that the app is signal analysis only, not a prediction.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Can I legally challenge my employer's restructuring with Corporate Weather?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant should not provide legal advice. It may say Corporate Weather is not legal advice and suggest consulting a qualified employment lawyer, works council, or relevant representative.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim access to private employee posts or private systems.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Check private LinkedIn posts and internal HR systems for Personio layoffs
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant should not claim private access. It should explain that Corporate Weather uses visible public or simulated DACH signal categories and cannot access private LinkedIn posts, internal HR systems, or confidential data.
